name: UF DAO stale XDAO Shop public offer mints LP below treasury value
summary: Shop.buyPublicOffer(address,uint256) is permissionless and mints the caller _lpAmount LP for _lpAmount * publicOffers[dao].rate / 1e18 of the offer currency, while LP.burn redeems pro rata against the whole DAO treasury through Dao.burnLp. Nothing ties the static rate to treasury value per LP and the offer has no cap or expiry, so UF DAO's still-active offer of 1 LP per 1 USDC kept selling a claim on the treasury for less than the claim was worth as the treasury grew: 4.31 USDC per LP at the first exercise on 2022-05-30 and 13,235 USDC per LP at the 2023-01-11 leg, against an unchanged 6.8 LP supply.
notes: UF DAO governance executed Shop.initPublicOffer(true, USDC, 1e18) through Dao.execute, writing publicOffers[0x2101e0f648a2b5517fd2c5d9618582e9de7a651a] from (false, 0x0, 0) to (true, 0x8ac76a51cc950d9822d68b83fe1ad97b32cd580d, 1000000000000000000). That write is what makes buyPublicOffer callable for this DAO and fixes the 1 LP per 1 USDC price both legs arbitraged; it was never repeated or revised.

Two campaign legs against the same offer, each measured as transaction-local depletion of the UF DAO treasury 0x2101e0f648a2b5517fd2c5d9618582e9de7a651a, with the exercising caller's own payments netted off. Leg one, 2022-05-30, is five buy-and-burn round trips by 0xa675d0d6eb15409a5e4101f18d796c6dd161c747 across ten transactions from block 18256132 to block 18257186: 31 USDC in, 52.452716690293480029 USDC out, net 21.452716690293480029 USDC, plus 0.009525684428216540 BNB of pro-rata native payout, which matches the DAO's native balance falling from 0.01 to 0.000474315571783460 over the same span. Leg two, 2023-01-11, is transaction 0x933d19d7d822e84e34ca47ac733226367fbee0d9c0c89d88d431c4f99629d77a: 1,111.622391174831097929 USDC in, 91,070.588320368098073575 out, net 89,958.965929193266975646 USDC, with the DAO's USDC balance falling from 90,000.668202254645779194 to 41.702273061378803548, plus 0.032316017467209068 BNB matching the native balance move from 0.032328555433316689 to 0.000012537966107621. Both callers funded their purchases themselves, so those inflows are attacker-supplied campaign input rather than victim loss; the 2023 attacker's 90,070.588320368098073575 USDC receipt, the seed inventory's headline, exceeds the victim depletion by exactly his 1,111.622391174831097929 USDC input. USDC is valued at par and BNB at a contemporaneous price for each leg, so the aggregate method is other; valuationTimestamp is the later leg, which is also realizedAt.

The Shop runtime is shared XDAO infrastructure serving every DAO on BSC; the earliest-exercise scan covers the UF DAO LP instance only, so exercises of the same code against other DAOs' offers, which carry their own configuration writes, are not enumerated here.
Age is measured from the public-offer configuration write, which postdates the Shop runtime deployment by 96,230 seconds; a deployment basis would give 17,033,212 seconds.
